WFLO is a Philanthropic Cryptocurrency Project Created to Promote Safe DeFi Adoption & Provide a Decentralized Educational Ecosystem with Unique Metaverse Integrations.

I am the founder of Wind Floki Inu, Jordan Austin. I am an engineer and have been a crypto enthusiast since 2018.

WFLO is a BSC token originally but is branching out to the Cardano blockchain with the aim of being the #1 meme token on the Cardano blockchain. Wind Floki Currently has two applications that are in the final stages of testing before being released to the public, Wind Floki plans to the the underdog of the metaverse.
